About Verax

Helping enterprises adopt Generative AI in a secure and compliant fashion.

Verax was founded to address the security and governance challenges of enterprise AI adoption. Organizations should leverage AI's productivity gains without sacrificing data protection or compliance.

Book a demoStart Free Assessment
Our Investors

Who We Are

Generative AI is reshaping enterprise computing while expanding the threat surface for data leakage and unauthorized use. Traditional security controls were not built for AI interactions.

Verax exists to solve these challenges. We empower organizations with real-time visibility, identity-aware governance, and policy enforcement across all Generative AI usage.

Our platform approach ensures that businesses can innovate with AI while maintaining control, trust, and compliance.

Our Mission

Our mission is to make generative AI adoption secure by default. We believe AI should be an asset enterprises can trust, where security and productivity coexist without slowing innovation. We focus on enabling organizations to confidently operationalize AI across every use case and user while maintaining strong governance and control.

Why This Matters

As AI becomes embedded in everyday workflows, traditional security controls struggle to adapt, resulting in shadow AI adoption, sensitive data shared with external tools, weak policy enforcement, and increased compliance exposure. Verax enables organizations to address these risks directly by ensuring secure, governed, and auditable AI usage.
